title: Sparrow release pocket and telemetry checkpad - Mar 2026 (draft)
content:
Purpose:
Quick, pocket-sized runbook for the Sparrow feature roll (small-batch canary -> 3-region ramp). Focus: short ops checklist, telemetry sampling plan, rollback ladder, and terse release notes to paste into release email.

Status note (TL;DR):
- Feature flags wired, bundle build green on main. Load test looks OK for baseline QPS.
- Remaining: final canary tweak for latency SLO, validate cold-start mem use on g4dn (edge).

Hour-by-hour ops slate (day-of, T+0):
- T-02: Preflight call (eng + sres + product + cs) 30m. Share canary cohort IDs. Owner: Jordan.
- T-01: Canary deploy to 2% traffic in us-west-2. Smoke tests (health endpoints, /v1/generate sanity). Owner: Eliot.
- T-00: Increase canary to 10% and open steady-state 15m watch. Owner: Priya.
- T+01: If telemetry steady, ramp to 30% and wait 30m. If not, follow rollback ladder.
- T+02 to T+06: Regional ramps (eu-west-1 then ap-southeast-1), each 30m watch.
- T+08: Full ramp (regional weights to target), run full-scope load profile for 60m.

Preflight checklist (quick checks, mark done during T-02 call):
- [ ] Canary image digest verified and pinned (sha).
- [ ] Feature flag config exists and test hook to disable globally.
- [ ] Healthcheck thresholds agreed: 95th latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.1%.
- [ ] Telemetry pipeline sampling set for sparrow-requests tag (10% detailed span, 100% metrics).
- [ ] Alert thresholds preloaded into pager duty escalation (latency/error/deadlocks).
- [ ] Rollback playbook posted and link pinned in Slack #deploys.
- [ ] Escalation rota confirmed for 12h post-ramp (on-call + backup).

Telemetry sampling plan (important - reduces noise but captures signal):
- Metrics (100%): latency_histogram, success_rate, cpu_util, mem_rss, queue_time. 30s resolution during canary, 15s resolution after ramp.
- Traces (10%): distributed traces for requests >= 500 tokens or latency > 250ms. Tag traces with "sparrow.cohort" and region.
- Logs (error-level 100%): include request_id, model_version, quant_profile.
- Synthetic checks: 1m cadence synthetic call hitting /v1/generate with canonical prompt_set/smoke. Fail if content regression (fuzzy match) or latency > 500ms.

Rollback ladder (fast, readable):
1) Pause ramp and revert canary weight to last good (owner Eliot).
2) Flip feature flag to previous state (global kill) if error or latency spikes persist.
3) If stateful failure detected, route traffic to fallback model variant (quantized safe variant) via routing policy.
4) If cluster-level issues, evict new pods and scale old replicas back to capacity.

Quick run commands (ops cheats):
- Verify service health: kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=sparrow -o wide
- Canary scale: ./deploy-sparrow --region us-west-2 --canary 10 --image sha:abcd1234
- Flip flag (console API): curl -X POST $CFG_API/flags/sparrow-enable -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN'

Release notes draft (paste-friendly, short):
- Sparrow: faster context trimming for long conversations. Adds partial prefix-caching to reduce token cost for repeated turns.
- Expected user impact: reduced median latency for multi-turn sessions by ~8-12% in our benchmarks. No model quality regressions expected.
- Rollout plan: staged canary -> regional ramp over 8 hours with telemetry watch.
- Rollback: quick disable via feature flag; fallback to sparrow-v0.9 quantized variant.

Open questions / things to validate before T-01:
- Can we verify cold-start memory leak hypothesis on g4dn? (Marisol to run stress binary)
- Do A/B evals (small prompt set) show any subtle hallucination pattern change? (Priya/Research)
- Is the quota guard for embeddings calls set correctly (we saw a misroute in last patch)?

Post-deploy checks (first 24h):
- Hourly snips: paste 1-line of 95th latency, error rate, CPU util into the release thread (owner rotates every hour).
- 4h: run 1k sample prompts through eval harness vs baseline. Flag any >2% quality divergence.
- 24h: compile release notes for product and cs (include regressions, mitigations, exposed incidents).

Postmortem template (if we fail):
- Short incident summary (what happened, when).
- Impact (customers, SLOs, pages).
- Root cause (data + hypothesis).
- Mitigation and short-term fix.
- Longer-term follow-up owners and deadlines.

Notes to self / operational gotchas:
- Prefix cache TTL mismatch in last deploy was due to a unit-test stub that didn't exercise TTL on restart. Add integration test to cover restart/rehydration.
- Watch rate-limit queue_time metric carefully — it climbs nonlinearly when batching backpressure starts.

References / quick links:
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sparrow/pull/342
- Perf dashboard: observability.redwood/sparrow/compare?range=24h
- Canary cohort list: confluence.redwood/internal/release/sparrow-cohorts

If anything goes sideways, follow the rollback ladder and file an incident. Keep notes minimal in the first hour; we need crisp signals, not speculation.

-- Jordan
(put this in the release binder and pin to deploy thread before T-02)
